The loss of my mother had been a great sorrow to me; but I must confess that to this grief had been added another, that of seeing myself--young, beautiful as I heard from every one that I was,--condemned to vegetate during a second winter in the country, in a barren solitude.

arxiv-1909-10159.title: Self-supervised 6D Object Pose Estimation for Robot Manipulation
arxiv-1909-10159.creator: Xinke Deng, Yu Xiang, Arsalan Mousavian, Clemens Eppner, Timothy Bretl, Dieter Fox
arxiv-1909-10159.description: Abstract To teach robots skills, it is crucial to obtain data with supervision. Since annotating real world data is time-consuming and expensive, enabling robots to learn in a self-supervised way is important. In this work, we introduce a robot system for self-supervised 6D object pose estimation.

arxiv-2211-05130.title: Fracton Matter
arxiv-2211-05130.creator: Andrey Gromov, Leo Radzihovsky
arxiv-2211-05130.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andrey Gromov, Leo Radzihovsky. We review a burgeoning field of “fractons” - a class of models where quasi-particles are strictly immobile or display restricted mobility that can be understood through generalized multipolar symmetries and associated conservation laws. Focusing on just a corner of this fast-growing subject, we will demonstrate how one class of such theories - symmetric tensor and coupled-vector gauge theories surprisingly emerge from familiar elasticity of a two-dimensional quantum crystal.

arxiv-2307-01497.title: Accelerated stochastic approximation with state-dependent noise
arxiv-2307-01497.creator: Sasila Ilandarideva 1, Anatoli Juditsky 1, Guanghui Lan 2, Tianjiao Li 2
arxiv-2307-01497.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sasila Ilandarideva 1, Anatoli Juditsky 1, Guanghui Lan 2, Tianjiao Li 2. We consider a class of stochastic smooth convex optimization problems under rather general assumptions on the noise in the stochastic gradient observation. As opposed to the classical problem setting in which the variance of noise is assumed to be uniformly bounded, herein we assume that the variance of stochastic gradients is related to the “sub-optimality” of the approximate solutions delivered by the algorithm.

arxiv-2307-11557.title: The ATLAS Readout System for LHC Runs 2 and 3
arxiv-2307-11557.creator: F.J. Wickens
arxiv-2307-11557.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by F.J. Wickens. The ReadOut System (ROS) is a central part of the data acquisition (DAQ) system of the ATLAS Experiment at the CERN Large Hadron Collider (LHC). The system is responsible for receiving and buffering event data from all detector subsystems and serving these to the High Level Trigger (HLT) system via a 10 GbE network, discarding or transporting data onward once the trigger has completed its selection process.

arxiv-2403-00897.title: VisRec: A Semi-Supervised Approach to Radio Interferometric Data Reconstruction
arxiv-2403-00897.creator: Ruoqi Wang, Haitao Wang, Qiong Luo, Feng Wang, Hejun Wu
arxiv-2403-00897.description: Abstract Radio telescopes produce visibility data about celestial objects, but these data are sparse and noisy. As a result, images created on raw visibility data are of low quality. Recent studies have used deep learning models to reconstruct visibility data to get cleaner images.

arxiv-2411-08720.title: Outsourced Cryptocurrency Wash Trading Thanks: I am grateful to Lin Peng, William Cong, and seminar participants at the Baruch–SWUFE seminar for helpful comments. A previous version of this paper was circulated under the title “How Wash Traders Exploit Market Conditions in Cryptocurrency Markets.”
arxiv-2411-08720.creator: Hunter Ng
arxiv-2411-08720.description: Abstract I show that outsourced cryptocurrency wash trading is shaped by the objective assigned to the outside firm. When hired to manufacture volume, wash traders buy and sell nearly equal amounts, repeatedly turning over the same inventory. When also tasked with selling issuer holdings, trading becomes markedly more one-sided, with sales exceeding purchases.

arxiv-2501-06306.title: On how traffic signals impact the fundamental diagrams of urban roads
arxiv-2501-06306.creator: Chao Zhang, Yechen Li, Neha Arora, Carolina Osorio
arxiv-2501-06306.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chao Zhang, Yechen Li, Neha Arora, Carolina Osorio. SHORT SUMMARY Being widely adopted by the transportation and planning practitioners, the fundamental diagram (FD) is the primary tool used to relate the key macroscopic traffic variables of speed, flow, and density. We empirically analyze the relation between vehicular space-mean speeds and flows given different signal settings and postulate a parsimonious parametric function form of the traditional FD where its function parameters are explicitly modeled as a function of the signal plan factors.

arxiv-2502-10953.title: Empirical evaluation of LLMs in predicting fixes of Configuration bugs in Smart Home System
arxiv-2502-10953.creator: Sheikh Moonwara Anjum Monisha (Author), Atul Bharadwaj (Author)
arxiv-2502-10953.description: Abstract This empirical study evaluates the effectiveness of Large Language Models (LLMs) in predicting fixes for configuration bugs in smart home systems. The research analyzes three prominent LLMs - GPT-4, GPT-4o (GPT-4 Turbo), and Claude 3.5 Sonnet - using four distinct prompt designs to assess their ability to identify appropriate fix strategies and generate correct solutions.

arxiv-2510-03772.title: Cooperation in public goods game on regular lattices with agents changing interaction groups Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2510-03772.creator: Jarosław Adam Miszczak
arxiv-2510-03772.description: Abstract The emergence of cooperation in the groups of interacting agents is one of the most fascinating phenomena observed in many complex systems studied in social science and ecology, even in the situations where one would expect the agent to use a free-rider policy.

arxiv-2602-04928.title: Euphonium: Steering Video Flow Matching via Process Reward Gradient Guided Stochastic Dynamics
arxiv-2602-04928.creator: Ruizhe Zhong, Jiesong Lian, Xiaoyue Mi, Zixiang Zhou, Yuan Zhou, Qinglin Lu, Junchi Yan
arxiv-2602-04928.description: Abstract While online Reinforcement Learning has emerged as a crucial technique for aligning flow matching models with human preferences, current approaches are hindered by inefficient exploration during training rollouts. Relying on undirected stochasticity and sparse outcome rewards, these methods struggle to discover high-reward samples, resulting in data-inefficient and slow optimization.

pmc-10644139.title: Comparison of compositional MRI techniques to quantify the regenerative potential of articular cartilage: a preclinical minipig model after osteochondral defect treatments with autologous mesenchymal stromal cells and unseeded scaffolds
pmc-10644139.creator: Karl Ludger Radke, Vera Grotheer, Benedikt Kamp, Anja Müller-Lutz, Justus Kertscher, Rosanna Strunk, Petros Martirosian, Birte Valentin, Hans-Jörg Wittsack, Martin Sager, Joachim Windolf, Gerald Antoch, Erik Schiffner, Pascal Jungbluth, Miriam Frenken

pmc-10752188.title: Radiographic Anatomy of the Lateral Ankle Ligament Complex: A Cadaveric Study
pmc-10752188.creator: Patrick J. Tansey, Jordan Robbins, Shepherd A. Stahel, Randal Morris, Daniel Jupiter, Jie Chen, Vinod Panchbhavi
pmc-10752188.description: Category:Ankle; SportsIntroduction/Purpose:Lateral ankle sprains are common orthopedic injuries that may progress on as chronic lateral ankle instability (CLAI). Great care must be taken to restore precise anatomic relationships of the lateral ankle ligament complex (LALC) in the surgical management of CLAI.

pmc-11454951.title: 6530 A Case of Lymphocytic Hypophysitis Followed by Acromegaly
pmc-11454951.creator: L Medina Mora, S Htoo, A Sanchez Ruiz, M Harshan, M Liu
pmc-11454951.description: Disclosure: L. Medina Mora: None. S. Htoo: None. A. Sanchez Ruiz: None. M. Harshan: None. M. Liu: None. Introduction: Acromegaly, a disorder with an estimated incidence of 0.28-0.4 cases per 100,000 individuals, is characterized by overproduction of growth hormone. Features include acral enlargement, frontal bossing, macrognathia, headaches, and hyperhidrosis. Comorbidities include hypertension, sleep apnea, type 2 diabetes, and cardiomyopathies.

pmc-11547817.title: Postprandial Metabolomic Profiling: Insights into Macronutrient-Specific Metabolic Responses in Healthy Individuals
pmc-11547817.creator: Awad Alshahrani, Shereen M. Aleidi, Mohammed Al Dubayee, Reem AlMalki, Rajaa Sebaa, Mahmoud Zhra, Anas M. Abdel Rahman, Ahmad Aljada
pmc-11547817.description: Background/Objectives: Understanding the metabolic responses to different macronutrients is crucial for assessing their impacts on health. This study aims to investigate the postprandial metabolomic profiles of healthy individuals following the consumption of glucose, protein, and lipids. Methods: Twenty-three healthy, normal-weight adults participated in the study, randomly assigned to consume 300 kcal from glucose, protein, or lipids after an overnight fast.

pmc-11682954.title: Applying a computer model to evaluate the evolution of resistance by western corn rootworm to multiple Bt traits in transgenic maize
pmc-11682954.creator: John B McCulloch, Aaron J Gassmann, Troy Anderson
pmc-11682954.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Western corn rootworm, Diabrotica virgifera virgifera (LeConte) (Coleoptera: Chrysomelidae), is a major pest of maize in the United States. Transgenic maize producing insecticidal toxins from the bacterium Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) have been used to manage this pest since 2003. Refuges of non-Bt maize have been used to delay resistance to Bt maize by western corn rootworm, and are planted in conjunction with maize producing single or multiple (i.e., pyramids) Bt toxins.

pmc-11752400.title: Management of a Rare Complex Triad Injury of the Elbow Joint: Radial Head Fracture, Triceps Tendon Avulsion, and Rupture of the Medial Collateral Ligament
pmc-11752400.creator: Abdelkader Shekhbihi, Mohammad Masoud, Winfried Reichert
pmc-11752400.description: Background:Isolated triceps tendon injuries are infrequent, and their combination with a medial ligament avulsion is even rarer. Eccentric force on the triceps tendon following a fall on the outstretched hand, combined with a valgus torque at the elbow joint, exposes the medial side to stretching forces, potentially disrupting the ulnar collateral ligament (UCL).

pmc-13096964.title: Mechanical activation of PIEZO1 drives AP-1–dependent PTGS2/PGE2 signaling and corneal inflammation
pmc-13096964.creator: Zongzheng Zou, Xiuqing Qian, Jifeng Ren, Yuqing Wang, Yuqi Liu, Aojun Luo, Mengyuan Guo, Hui Tong, Ruiran Li, Shanshan Li, Haixia Zhang
pmc-13096964.description: SummaryAbnormal mechanical stimulation, such as eye rubbing, is a critical risk factor for corneal diseases, yet the molecular mechanisms linking mechanical stimulation to inflammation remain unclear. Here, we show that mechanical stretch directly activates the mechanosensitive ion channel PIEZO1 in human corneal fibroblasts, leading to Ca2+ influx and activation of the AP-1 transcription factor.

pmc-13221160.title: Effects of Multicomponent Digital Health Interventions on Multidimensional Physical Activity in Older Adults: Systematic Review, Meta-Analysis, and Meta-Regression of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13221160.creator: Jiayi Yao, Haozhe Wang, Shiguan Jia, Hao Chen, Junhao He, Juncheng Long, Shengxian Chen
pmc-13221160.description: BackgroundThe comprehensive effects of multicomponent digital health interventions (DHIs) on multidimensional physical activity indicators and sedentary behavior (SB) remain controversial.ObjectiveThis systematic review aimed to evaluate the impact of multicomponent DHIs on daily steps, moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA), light physical activity, total physical activity, and SB in older adults.
